title: RoomGraph
description: The abstract room-adjacency graph the layout model emits: topology ONLY (rooms with roles, which rooms connect, the entry, the goal room), never coordinates. The deterministic solver owns all geometry. This is the grammar-constrainable shape the LLM is limited to (see 04-TECH-STACK.md: the model is trusted with the abstract graph, never with placement or connectivity proofs).

role.description: A rough role hint, e.g. entry, chamber, hall, vault, goal. Advisory; the solver does not depend on it.

edges.description: Undirected adjacencies as [roomIdA, roomIdB] pairs. Advisory: the solver realises an edge as a doorway only when the two rooms end up sharing a wall, and guarantees full connectivity regardless.

goalRoom.description: The room the goal target lives in (defaults to the last room).
